title: Temu Intellectual Property Policy
content:
# Intellectual Property Policy
## Trademark Infringement
1. Sellers must not list counterfeit goods or commit trademark infringement.
2. Temu may remove listings after an intellectual property complaint.
## Appeals
- Sellers may appeal a removal.
Example: A listing using another brand logo may be removed.
